name: 刻名
text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——目标受到{d}点伤害。
flavor: 碑上无字，便刻你的。

art.subject: a spectral chisel hovering over a blank tombstone, carving a glowing name stroke by stroke while grey dust drifts down in moonlight

name: 无字判
text: [判定]：阳纹——对敌方主帅造成{d}点伤害；阴纹——你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
flavor: 无字之碑，判起人来最公平——谁都没有名字。

art.subject: a towering blank stone tablet splitting a falling fate card in half with a crack of pale light, a lone figure recoiling below

name: 立碑
text: 召唤{n}座无字碑。
flavor: 石头不会退，也不会疼。

art.subject: a squat stone guardian statue with a cracked blank face planted among gravestones, moss on its shoulders, cold fog behind it

name: 泼墨
text: 造成{d}点伤害，施加{w}层[虚弱]。
flavor: 一团墨，便是一个人的一生被涂去。

art.subject: a splash of black ink shaped like a grasping hand bursting across the air toward a warrior, droplets frozen mid-flight in dim light

name: 月书
text: [观星]{n}，你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
flavor: 月光照在碑上，字便换了次序。

art.subject: three fate cards floating in a column of cold moonlight above a stone tablet, slowly rotating as a veiled hand rearranges them

name: 抹字
text: 造成{d}点伤害；若目标身上有[延时]牌，改为造成{e}点伤害。
flavor: 刻上去的名字，也最容易抹掉。

art.subject: a grey stone thumb smearing a glowing inscription off a tomb face, the light tearing loose like smoke and striking a distant figure

name: 锈戟
text: 装备（武器，耐久{n}）：你的主帅攻击伤害+{a}。
flavor: 锈得越厉害，砍进去越难拔出来。

art.subject: a massive rust-eaten halberd planted upright in a battlefield of broken shields, flakes of rust drifting in a dull orange dusk

name: 催阵鼓
text: 阵地，持续{t}回合：你方单位攻击力+{a}。
flavor: 鼓皮早就烂了，鼓声却一直在响。

art.subject: a tattered war drum on a skeletal frame beating by itself in a misty graveyard, ghostly soldiers stirring in rows behind it

name: 点兵
text: 召唤{n}名锈甲亲兵。
flavor: “到！”——坟里有人应了一声。

art.subject: a rusted armored soldier clawing up out of a grave mound, raising his shield toward a commander's banner in grey morning fog

name: 铁雨
text: 对所有敌方角色造成{d}点伤害。
flavor: 三百年前射出的箭，今天才落地。

art.subject: a dense volley of rusted arrows arcing down from a storm-dark sky onto a battle line, shields raised, sparks where iron meets iron

name: 军法
text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数不大于{k}——目标受到{d}点伤害。
flavor: 军中无戏言，点数小者斩。

art.subject: a rusted executioner's command token hanging over a kneeling silhouette, a fate card flipping in the air beside it, harsh torchlight

name: 列盾
text: 你方所有角色获得{a}点[护甲]。
flavor: 盾挨着盾，死人挨着死人。

art.subject: a row of undead soldiers locking rust-pitted shields into a wall, bracing together under a hail of light, dust kicked up at their feet

name: 狐火
text: 造成{d}点伤害，施加{b}层[灼烧]。
flavor: 青色的火，烧的不是皮肉，是记忆。

art.subject: a swirl of pale blue fox-fire orbs spiraling around a startled traveler at night, reflections dancing on wet gravestones

name: 魅惑
text: 施加{w}层[虚弱]与{v}层[易伤]。
flavor: “你叫什么名字？”——千万别回答。

art.subject: a beautiful woman's face half-hidden behind a silk fan, fox ears faintly visible in shadow, her gaze pulling a thread of light from a warrior's chest

name: 狐契
text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：{moon}月纹——目标失去{d}点生命；{mountain}山纹——目标获得{w}层[虚弱]与{w}层[易伤]。
flavor: 契约写在月下，签名的是你的影子。

art.subject: a paper contract sealed with a fox paw print floating under a crescent moon, its edges curling into blue flame

name: 三尾卜
text: [判定]：阳纹——召唤{n}只狐影；阴纹——你的主帅恢复{h}点生命。
flavor: 三条尾巴各指一方，狐母只信最坏的那条。

art.subject: three glowing fox tails fanning out behind a crouching fox spirit, each tail tip touching a floating fate card in a moonlit clearing

name: 噬名宴
text: 对敌方主帅造成{d}点伤害，你的主帅恢复等同于其失去生命值的生命。
flavor: 名字入口即化，回味是那人的一生。

art.subject: a fox spirit inhaling a ribbon of glowing written characters drawn out of a kneeling warrior's mouth, lantern light flickering

name: 潮痕
text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：阴纹——目标受到{d}点伤害并获得{f}层[冰冻]。
flavor: 水涨到哪里，命就淹到哪里。

art.subject: a dark waterline creeping up a warrior's armor, frost blooming where it touches, murky water rising in a drowned palace hall

name: 暗流
text: 对一个敌方单位造成{d}点伤害并施加{f}层[冰冻]，然后将其移至后排。
flavor: 湖面平静，湖底有手。

art.subject: a swirling black current dragging a soldier backward through waist-deep water, pale hands visible beneath the surface

name: 水漫金殿
text: 阵地，持续{t}回合：敌方角色受到的伤害+{a}。
flavor: 金殿沉了三百年，水从未退过。

art.subject: a golden throne hall flooding with green lake water pouring through shattered windows, floating banners and drifting lanterns

name: 溺拽
text: 造成{d}点伤害；若目标处于[冰冻]，再造成{d}点伤害。
flavor: 冻住的人最好拽，连挣扎都省了。

art.subject: a bloated drowned hand bursting from icy water to seize a frozen warrior's ankle, cracks spreading across the ice

name: 珊瑚甲
text: 装备（防具）：你的回合开始时，你的主帅获得{a}点[护甲]。
flavor: 珊瑚一年长一分，这副甲长了三百年。

art.subject: an ornate suit of armor grown from red and white coral branches standing on a sunken dais, small fish drifting through its gaps

name: 贡珠
text: 你的主帅恢复{h}点生命并获得{r}层[再生]。
flavor: 溺死的臣子仍在进贡，贡品是自己的眼泪。

art.subject: a kneeling drowned courtier offering a tray of luminous pearls upward, the pearls glowing softly in murky blue water

name: 牵丝
text: 你方所有单位获得+{a}攻击力与{b}点[护甲]。
flavor: 丝一紧，木头也会咬牙。

art.subject: glinting silver threads descending from darkness into the joints of several wooden puppets, jerking them into combat stances

name: 机关弩台
text: [远射]。你的回合开始时：对敌方主帅造成{d}点伤害。
flavor: 它不需要人拉弦，只需要一个目标。

art.subject: a clockwork crossbow turret of lacquered wood and brass gears on spider-like legs, a bolt ready to fire, gears glinting in lamplight

name: 机关木墙
text: 召唤{n}面机关木墙（[坚守]，[棘刺]{th}）。
flavor: 墙上的钉子都朝外，一根也没朝里。

art.subject: a folding wall of interlocking wooden panels bristling with iron spikes, unfolding itself across a flooded corridor

name: 备件
text: 召唤{n}具木傀，你方所有单位恢复{h}点生命。
flavor: 手断了换手，头断了换头。

art.subject: a workbench heaped with wooden limbs and heads, silk threads snapping them together into a new puppet that rises from the pile

name: 千针雨
text: 对所有敌方角色造成{d}点伤害。
flavor: 机括一响，满殿都是针。

art.subject: hundreds of steel needles bursting from hidden slots in a lacquered wall, streaking across a dim hall like silver rain

name: 生死簿
text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数{lo}至{hi}——目标失去{d}点生命；阴纹——目标获得{w}层[虚弱]。
flavor: 簿上有你的名字，旁边还空着一格。

art.subject: an ancient ledger bound in black leather lying open on a judge's desk, a vermilion brush poised above a name as candlelight gutters

name: 阴判令
text: [判定]：阳纹——造成{d}点伤害并施加{v}层[易伤]；阴纹——你获得{n}枚[命签]。
flavor: 阴司的令牌是冷的，冷得烫手。

art.subject: a black iron command token engraved with a crescent, thrown from the shadows and trailing violet sparks toward a startled figure

name: 阳判令
text: [判定]：阳纹——你方所有角色恢复{h}点生命；阴纹——你方所有角色获得{a}点[护甲]。
flavor: 阳司的令牌是暖的，暖得像一场骗局。

art.subject: a gilded command token engraved with a sun rising above a judge's bench, radiating warm light over kneeling spectral clerks

name: 朱笔勾魂
text: 若目标敌方单位生命值不高于{n}，将其消灭；否则对其造成{d}点伤害。
flavor: 一勾，一个名字；一点，一条命。

art.subject: a giant vermilion brush sweeping a single red stroke through the air, the stroke cutting through a soldier who dissolves into ink

name: 渊视
text: [观星]{n}，然后你获得{m}枚[命签]。
flavor: 湖底有一面镜子，照得见明天。

art.subject: a huge pale eye opening at the bottom of a dark lake, fate cards drifting upward past it like fallen leaves

name: 记过
text: [延时]{t}：[判定]：点数不大于{k}——目标受到{d}点伤害并获得{w}层[虚弱]。
flavor: 过记三笔，就该去堂上走一趟了。

art.subject: a ghostly clerk inking a mark into a damp ledger by a green lantern, a faint chain of light reaching from the page to a distant figure

name: 潮鼓
text: 阵地，持续{t}回合：你方的攻击伤害+{a}。
flavor: 湖底擂鼓，湖面起浪。

art.subject: a colossal barnacle-crusted drum on the lakebed struck by drowned soldiers, shockwaves rippling upward through green water

name: 镜花
text: 你的主帅获得{w}层[灵障]并恢复{h}点生命。
flavor: 你砍中的，只是镜中花。

art.subject: a translucent flower of mirror shards blooming in front of a pale woman, a sword strike shattering harmlessly against its petals
